name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-mcs-MakerSupportAssistant
title: Maker Support Assistant
shortDescription: A Copilot Studio agent that answers Power Platform questions from Microsoft Learn, checks the user's own environments and flows, and logs support requests.
longDescription: Maker Support Assistant helps Power Platform makers, developers and administrators build, understand and troubleshoot their solutions. It combines the Microsoft Learn Docs MCP Server with Power Automate Management connector tools to answer how-to questions and look up the user's own environments and cloud flows. When it can't solve a problem, it logs a support request in Dataverse through an agent flow and replies with an Adaptive Card confirmation.
